The good news is that 'Elf' is a sweet-natured show that should please families looking for holiday entertainment. The bad news is that it's also determinedly mediocre.

The onstage Buddy (Sebastian Arcelus played the part in 2010) is sometimes naïve, sometimes perceptive and too often uncomfortably close to mentally disabled — an awkward mix that makes it difficult to buy into the whole “Elf” fantasy.
But that spark of comic genius needed to carry the show eludes him.
Leslie Kritzer delivers the funny 'Never Fall in Love (With an Elf)' with wry pizzazz.

cn.t: This holiday musical delivers family-friendly cheer but dilutes the film's sharper humor into something safe and mediocre, though polished production numbers and a strong second act provide seasonal entertainment.
